source_and_math_contract.series_policy: One explicit whole census and whole independent flow source per day, or explicit unknown; all relevant roots, their current governance, full manifests, per-member reviews and five coverage declarations are frozen. Today Bed.status/admission records do not reconstruct historical observations.
source_and_math_contract.count_policy: Zero, unknown and not_recorded remain distinct. Observed, recorded, UTC day boundaries and reviewed future scenario clocks remain separate. Flow-day counts are actual independent events, not inferred census changes or unmet demand.
source_and_math_contract.forecast_policy: Five targets have independent completeness. Fixed four-week same-weekday primary and three baselines; 28 rolling origins, horizon7/14 gives196/392 pairs and34/41 unique scored dates. Calibration uses information before each origin; no historical availability replay or real-effect validation is claimed.
source_and_math_contract.arithmetic_policy: Canonical exact rational numerators/denominators and large integers retain native text. Zero WAPE/MASE denominators are undefined, not zero error. Last calendar day and last eligible observation are separate.
source_and_math_contract.capacity_policy: Historical observed capacity requires positive overlap; reviewed future scenarios may witness the final census instant. Total operational physical capacity is not instantaneous admittability. Three readiness facts remain independent; actual IANA23/25-hour days, half-open pressure and zero-capacity null ratios retain exact semantics.
source_and_math_contract.outbound_policy: Typed public source and explicit horizon only. Private source text, ward/person identities, bed cohort, free question and private evidence stay in hospital-side frozen records. Public projection/private SHA/runtime/horizon/math are independently rebound and full analysis recomputed.

super_admin_governance.originals_and_series: Independent draft/review/publish/reject/revoke and all-hospital frozen audit; ordinary recording/current scope and Super governance use actual capabilities, not fabricated clinical qualification.
super_admin_governance.provider_prompt_execution_controls: Super manages saved provider/model, feature roles, enablement, independent prompt, operational validation and audits. Capability check is authenticated GET metadata through admin wrapper; it neither forecasts nor enables nor validates the feature.
super_admin_governance.normal_operational_gate: Features62..67 ordinary execution requires validation_status=validated. Super preview/source publication is not operational validation.
super_admin_governance.lifecycle: Current scope and all source/cohort/manifest/runtime bindings are checked for queue, in-flight acceptance, normal history, evidence and feedback. Super can audit its intact frozen proof. Current and late stale token/role/department/ward/source/config/mode/deactivation responses cannot restore previous private data.
super_admin_governance.queue_receipt: Source queue POST is strictly typed short metadata, followed by exact requested-run GET full detail. Short or mismatched IDs are not interpreted as a full result.
